records.subject: Re: The VAT invoice
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for the note about the VAT invoice -- looking into it now, will follow up soon.

Thanks so much,
Tariq Diallo
Would it be possible to get an invoice with our VAT number included for accounting purposes?

records.subject: Still want to get Ridge Collective set up on Wrenfield?
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Good to see Ridge Collective has a real project going. Let me know if you want a second pair of eyes on how it's structured.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Ridge Collective
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Your workspace for Ridge Collective is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Project created day 1 and one invite sent ([email:2b6439dc] confirms a real project), so some momentum exists. But no customer reply to either outreach or after the welcome call ([calendar:ce068191]), no key milestone by day 6, starter plan, 8 days left. Silence after early setup suggests a coin-flip-at-best unaided.

draft.subject: Next step inside your Ridge Collective project
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Good to see your first project up and running since our welcome call. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the next useful step is getting the real work for Ridge Collective into that project.

Would a short call this week work? I can look at how the project is structured with you and help you map out what belongs inside it. Happy to work over email instead if that's easier.

Best,
Chidi
